glossary.rowNote: Say which words should be rendered your way
glossary.title: My glossary
glossary.intro: Write down the renderings you want to read. When these words appear in your reading, Sensa prefers your wording over its own.
glossary.empty: The glossary is empty. With no entries, translation uses the model’s own wording.
glossary.limit: Up to {{count}} entries per language direction. Delete some before adding more.
glossary.totalLimit: The glossary holds up to {{count}} entries in total. Delete some before adding more.
glossary.hint: The glossary affects wording only: it cannot change meaning and cannot promise the model follows it. Text that is already translated is not translated again on its own.
glossary.failed: That entry could not be saved. Try again.

languages.title: Language routes
languages.routesNote: The active route affects only future learning, reading, and semantic work. Sessions already underway keep their original language context.
languages.sameLanguageNote: Target and support may be the same language, for example in an immersion route.

libraryBackup.title: Backup & restore
libraryBackup.intro: Save your local content and learning progress to restore in another browser.
libraryBackup.size: Current raw backup data: about {{used}} MiB of the {{capacity}} MiB limit. Encoding makes the encrypted file larger.
libraryBackup.sizeWarning: Raw backup data is near its limit: {{used}} MiB of {{capacity}} MiB. Export a backup now and reduce large media before adding more data.
libraryBackup.detailText: Includes source material, conversations, meanings, learning resources and history. Sign-in credentials and API keys are excluded; reconnect custom services after restoring.
libraryBackup.passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters. Keep this password: it cannot be recovered.
libraryBackup.restoreHint: To restore, sign in to the original account in an empty browser library.
libraryBackup.exported: Backup created. Check that the downloaded file has been saved.
libraryBackup.restored: Library restored. Reopen the app to continue learning.
libraryBackup.summary: Sources: {{drafts}} · Meanings: {{meanings}} · Packages: {{packages}} · Learning items: {{targets}} · Runs: {{runs}} · Events: {{events}}
libraryBackup.interrupted: {{count}} unfinished requests will stop. Retry them manually after restoring.
libraryBackup.failed: The operation failed. Your existing content is unchanged. Please try again.
libraryBackup.tooLarge: Backup files must be smaller than 90 MiB.

errors.fileTooLarge: Backup files must be smaller than 90 MiB.
errors.invalidFile: Incorrect password, damaged file or unsupported backup version. Your existing content is unchanged.
errors.tables: The backup contains missing or incompatible tables.
errors.records: The backup contains too many records or duplicate identifiers.
errors.authorization: Login and device authorizations cannot be restored from a backup.
errors.recordKey: This library contains unsupported record identifiers.
errors.rowLimit: This library exceeds the 200,000-record backup limit. Keep your existing data.
errors.sizeLimit: This library exceeds the 64 MiB backup limit. Keep your existing data.
errors.accountMismatch: This backup belongs to another account. Sign in to the original account in an empty browser library.
errors.occupied: This library already contains data. Use a new browser profile and sign in to the original account to restore.
errors.depth: The backup data is nested too deeply.
errors.valueType: The backup contains an unsupported data type.
errors.format: The backup data format is invalid.
errors.fields: The backup contains duplicate or invalid fields.
errors.inconsistent: Backup records are incomplete or inconsistent. Nothing was restored.

modelService.purposeTeacherHint: Used when you ask and get explanations in a conversation.
modelService.purposeContentHint: Used when learning material is prepared and candidates are generated.
modelService.purposeReviewHint: When enabled, generated material gets one extra independent review.
modelService.purposeReferenceHint: Used when you look up a word, to decide which sense fits this sentence.
modelService.reviewNote: Code validation always runs. With review enabled, generated material also goes through one model review and uses one material-preparation allowance.
modelService.usageNote: Last 24 hours, counting only requests executed on the Sensa service. Local connections do not use these allowances.
modelService.localGroupNote: The key lives in page memory only, so you re-enter it after a reload. Requests go straight from this device, so your service must allow browser requests.
modelService.accountGroupNote: The key is kept in an encrypted vault on the Sensa service, so it survives a browser change. Requests run on the service.
modelService.localEmpty: No connection on this device yet.
modelService.accountLoginRequired: Sign in to Sensa to manage account connections.
modelService.keyAbsent: No key set for this page
modelService.name: Name
modelService.keyNote: The key stays in page memory only; enter it again after a reload.
modelService.accountKeyNote: The key will be stored on the service, encrypted with the deployment key. Continue only if you trust this deployment.
modelService.accountKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved key.
modelService.allowedOrigins: The service currently supports these addresses:
modelService.readFailed: Could not load model settings. Please try again.
modelService.saveFailed: Could not save settings. Please try again.
modelService.statusFailed: Service status is unavailable. Please try again.

support.aboutText: Start with a specific meaning, connect it with an expression, and build familiarity through learning and review.
support.privacyText: Content and learning progress are stored in this browser first. When you sign in, supported records are synchronized as the current account checkpoint; sync is not a versioned backup. Clearing website data removes local and unsynced records. Account deletion removes the server-side account copy, but offline copies in other browsers must be cleared on those devices.
support.providersText: A configured model provider receives the text or images required for the model request. The default client speech provider receives the text, language and selected voice needed to synthesize audio. Dictionary and YouGlish requests send the lookup query and ordinary network metadata to those services. Custom providers apply their own terms and retention policies.
support.retentionText: Short-lived semantic lookup payloads expire after 24 hours. Successful managed-model responses are retained for up to 6 hours and request metadata for up to 26 hours. The current cloud-sync checkpoint and account content remain until replaced or deleted. Encrypted backup files remain wherever you save them.
support.feedbackText: Contact support for product feedback, content corrections, account recovery, or deletion questions. Attach the diagnostic file only when it helps; it contains runtime state and counts, not learning content, email addresses, record identifiers, URLs, tokens, or stacks.
support.unavailable: Support contact is not configured for this build. Do not release this build to users.
support.diagnosticsText: Download a local JSON report with release, browser capability, storage, and sync state. Review it before attaching it to a support request.
support.diagnosticsFailed: Diagnostics could not be prepared. Contact support without an attachment.
